description: One venue: access, minimum age, opening hours, services with prices, reservation and its menu sections. Hours, prices and access as published on the website (they may change; hours may vary by season). access: hotel_guests, other_guests with their condition, external_guests, min_age with age_note. The connector does not reserve tables or treatments; reservation has the reservation URL and phones of the venue, and reservation null means that the website offers no reservation. What a board (half board, all inclusive) includes is not part of this answer. API v3.

lang.description: Language of names, texts and links: de or en (default en).

venue.description: Venue id, e.g. restaurant-ophelia, bar-c, wellness-harmony.
